title: THE HALLOWEEN ISSUE · The cafeteria at night
venue: the Timberline · an unpublished Halloween issue · Box 1
logline: An issue that never went to the copier: the cafeteria at night, the tables up, the lunch lady's hairnet on a hook, and the tray line moving with no one at it. Wood and Gully in with a flashlight because Chloe dared them. The spotting is the horror. Two by two.

panels.composition: The cafeteria at night, tables upended, a flashlight beam. WOOD and GULLY in the doorway.

balloons.text: She dared us. That's not the same as us having to.
